_meta.purpose: the three capture-and-overlay pairs for the hero plate strip, per refrences/pintest_layouts/visual-language.html :: P id 5 :: plate
_meta.selection_rule: minimum, median and maximum measured `sky` over the points that carry one — the instrument's own range, not an eye pick
_meta.overlaid_class: Cityscapes `sky` — the class the `sky` metric counts, so the overlay and the number are the same measurement
_meta.caveat: street-level context exposure, not on-deck view
_meta.coverage_note: Southern-corridor pilot: imagery exists for transect points 8-47 only. Bins 0-2 and 28-47 have no CV data and are coverage:'none' with null metrics; null means unmeasured, 0.0 is a real measured value.
_meta.numbers_are_not_stored_twice: sky_measured is copied from data/highline_exposure.json for the caption; sky_recomputed_here is this run's own mask fraction, kept separate so the two can be compared rather than conflated
